description: Shell script for performance testing the core.fsmonitor feature in Git. It sets up different configurations, runs performance benchmarks, and manages external dependencies like Watchman and built-in fsmonitor daemon. The script includes setup routines, environment configuration, and test execution flows for various scenarios involving the file system change monitor.

methods.name: trace_start
methods.description: Initializes trace logging if tracing is enabled via environment variable GIT_PERF_7519_TRACE. Sets up directories and environment variables for trace output.

methods.name: trace_stop
methods.description: Stops trace logging by unsetting the GIT_TRACE2_PERF environment variable.

methods.name: touch_files
methods.description: Creates a specified number of files in a directory, touching each to update mtimes.
